Etizolam and Oxycodone
To start off I am an 19 year old male, currently in school studying pharmacology. I have been recently experimenting with Etizolam as an alternative for Alprazolam. I will use Oxycodone for recreational purposes here and there but my tolerance is very low. So one night after a solid 12 hour work shift I felt combining the two substances. To start I insufflated 30mg of Oxycodone Hydrocloride (Not a lot of powder and goes up like air) then immediately after I had two 1mg lines of pure Etizolam powder(no fillers at all). The almost instant rush of blissfulness and warming euphoria from the oxycodone was amazing, combined with the etizolam it was an outstanding combo. I was completely painless and the relaxation was like nothing I have ever had before. Overall it was amazing but the potential for abuse seems extremely high.
